THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Snickerdoodle Skillet Cookie Protein Creami

CrumblCreamiCut Week 11 Flavor 1 — vanilla-cinnamon protein Creami with Cinnamon Toast Crunch through Mix-In and a melted Lily's white chocolate drizzle plus more cereal on top. About 400 calories and 41g protein for the complete pint.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME10 min active + overnight freeze
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~400 cal | ~41g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Vanilla and cinnamon go into the base BEFORE freezing — 1 tsp each. That's the snickerdoodle backbone.

Ingredients

CREAMI BASE

  • 1 batch usual protein Creami base (240 cal / 40g protein)
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract (blend into base before freezing)
  • 1 tsp ground cinnamon (blend into base before freezing)

MIX-IN (after the first spin)

  • 10g Cinnamon Toast Crunch

TOPPING

  • 14g Lily's white chocolate chips (melted)
  • 10g Cinnamon Toast Crunch (crunchy topping)

Allergens: dairy, wheat, gluten, soy. Cinnamon Toast Crunch contains wheat/gluten and soy. Lily's white chocolate contains milk and soy lecithin, and the protein base contains dairy. Verify the current physical labels before publishing final allergen tags.

You want a snickerdoodle-skillet whole-pint Creami — warm vanilla-cinnamon base, Cinnamon Toast Crunch crunch, and melted white chocolate drops — with enough protein to work as a Powerup. Week 11 Flavor 1 of the CrumblCreamiCut series recreating current Crumbl flavors.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND BASE. Blend 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon into your usual protein Creami base until completely smooth.
  2. 2.FREEZE. Pour into a Creami pint without exceeding the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level overnight.
  3. 3.FIRST SPIN. Rest the pint 5 minutes, then process on Regular Ice Cream. If it stays powdery, run one no-liquid Respin before the mix-in.
  4. 4.MIX-IN THE CEREAL. Add 10g Cinnamon Toast Crunch and run Mix-In.
  5. 5.MELT THE WHITE CHOCOLATE. Melt 14g Lily's white chocolate chips until smooth and pourable.
  6. 6.SCOOP + FINISH. Scoop the Creami into a bowl, drizzle the melted white chocolate, and top with the remaining 10g Cinnamon Toast Crunch. Eat immediately for the intended texture.

Keys to success

  • The two cereal portions are separate: 10g goes in on Mix-In (after the first spin), 10g goes on top at the end. Both are counted in the 400-calorie total.
  • Melt the Lily's white chocolate and drizzle it AFTER scooping so it sets in glossy drops instead of disappearing into the pint.

If something fails

Powdery after Regular Ice Cream: Run one no-liquid Respin before adding the cereal.

White chocolate seizes when melting: Melt Lily's chips low and slow in short bursts, stirring between. Overheating seizes white chocolate.

Cereal goes soft: Add the 10g topping cereal at the very end, right before eating — don't let the finished bowl sit.

Texture is gummy: The guar gum in the base was likely heaped. Use a level measure.

Not cinnamon-forward enough: Confirm a full teaspoon of cinnamon in the base; the cereal alone won't carry it.

Storage and reheating

Store: Keep the unprocessed base frozen upright and level. Melt the white chocolate and process only when ready to eat.

Reheat: N/A. If the processed base is powdery, use a no-liquid Respin before the mix-in.

Lasts: The frozen pre-spin pint keeps up to one week. The finished pint is best immediately after Mix-In and drizzle.

~400 cal | ~41g protein.

Flavor target

First bite: warm cinnamon and vanilla from the base. Middle: creamy ultra-filtered-milk and whey body. Finish: the cinnamon-sugar crunch of Cinnamon Toast Crunch and glossy melted-white-chocolate drops that echo the skillet cookie.
